items.title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems
items.title_zh: 记忆即代谢：伴侣型知识系统的设计
items.summary: The paper surveys the April 2026 cluster of personal wiki-style memory architectures alongside production memory systems and a research lineage including MemGPT, Generative Agents, Mem0 and Zep, then proposes a companion-specific governance profile with normative obligations, a time-structured procedural rule and testable conformance invariants for entrenchment under user-coupled drift. Its design splits mirroring the user on operational dimensions from compensating on epistemic failure modes through five operations: TRIAGE, DECAY, CONTEXTUALIZE, CONSOLIDATE and AUDIT.

items.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?
items.title_zh: 从计划到行动：智能体在多大程度上遵循计划？
items.summary: The first extensive systematic analysis of plan compliance examines 21,120 SWE-agent trajectories across four LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro under eight plan variations, finding that without an explicit plan agents fall back on incomplete or overfit internalized workflows. A standard plan improves issue resolution, periodic reminders reduce violations, and a subpar plan hurts performance more than no plan at all.

items.title: Towards Platonic Representation for Table Reasoning: A Foundation for Permutation-Invariant Retrieval
items.title_zh: 面向表格推理的柏拉图表示：排列不变检索的基础
items.summary: The paper argues that linearizing tables into sequences discards geometric and relational structure, leaving representations brittle to layout permutations, and proposes permutation invariance as a requirement for robust table latents. Using CKA-based metrics it shows minor layout changes cause disproportionate shifts in LLM table embeddings, and presents a structure-aware encoder enforcing cell-header alignment with greater geometric stability.

items.title: ViLL-E: Video LLM Embeddings for Retrieval
items.title_zh: ViLL-E：面向检索的视频 LLM 嵌入
items.summary: ViLL-E is a unified VideoLLM architecture whose embedding mechanism can spend more computation on complex videos and stop early on easy ones, trained in three stages that combine generative and contrastive learning. The authors report average gains of 7% in temporal localization and up to 4% in video retrieval, plus zero-shot improvements of 5% in composed video retrieval and 2% in retrieval from long text.

items.title: Narrative over Numbers: The Identifiable Victim Effect and its Amplification Under Alignment and Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 叙事胜过数字：大语言模型中的可识别受害者效应及其在对齐与推理下的放大
items.summary: Across 51,955 API trials with 16 frontier models, the study finds the identifiable victim effect is prevalent but modulated by alignment: instruction-tuned models show extreme effects (Cohen's d up to 1.56) while reasoning-specialized models invert it (down to d=-0.85). Standard chain-of-thought prompting nearly triples the effect size, and only utilitarian chain-of-thought reliably eliminates it.

items.title: Solving Physics Olympiad via Reinforcement Learning on Physics Simulators
items.title_zh: 通过物理模拟器上的强化学习求解物理奥林匹克竞赛题
items.summary: The authors generate random scenes in physics engines, create synthetic question-answer pairs from simulated interactions, and train LLMs with reinforcement learning on this data, reporting zero-shot sim-to-real transfer that improves IPhO performance by 5-10 percentage points across model sizes.

items.title: NL2SQLBench: A Modular Benchmarking Framework for LLM-Enabled NL2SQL Solutions
items.title_zh: NL2SQLBench：面向 LLM 驱动 NL2SQL 方案的模块化基准框架
items.summary: NL2SQLBench dissects NL2SQL systems into schema selection, candidate generation and query revision, proposes fine-grained module-level metrics and implements them in a configurable multi-agent framework. Evaluating ten open-source methods on BIRD and ScienceBenchmark with DeepSeek-V3 and GPT-4o mini, it finds substantial room for accuracy gains plus significant computational inefficiency and issues with gold SQL annotations and evaluation rules.

items.title: REGREACT: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Pipelines for Structured Regulatory Information Extraction
items.title_zh: RegReAct：面向结构化监管信息抽取的自校正多智能体流水线
items.summary: RegReAct decomposes regulatory information extraction into seven stages, each with an observe-diagnose-repair loop that validates outputs against the source and also corrects cross-reference errors in the regulations. Applied to three EU Taxonomy Delegated Acts, it builds a dataset of 242 activities with over 4,800 hierarchical criteria and outperforms a GPT-4o single-pass baseline on structural and semantic metrics.

items.title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越感知错误：大型视觉语言模型中的语义固着
items.summary: The paper introduces semantic fixation, the tendency of vision-language models to retain a default interpretation even when a prompt specifies an alternative equally valid mapping, and builds VLM-Fix, a benchmark over four abstract strategy games with paired standard and inverse rules. Across 14 open and closed VLMs accuracy favored standard rules, neutral alias prompts narrowed the inverse-rule gap, semantically loaded aliases reopened it, and late-layer activation steering partially recovered performance.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Must Move Beyond Factual Grounding to Represent Diverse Opinions
items.title_zh: 检索增强生成必须超越事实依据，以呈现多元观点
items.summary: This position paper argues that RAG's assumption that queries have correct answers creates a factual bias that ignores aleatoric uncertainty in opinion-rich content and risks erasing minority voices or enabling opinion manipulation. It proposes Opinion-Aware RAG, which adds LLM-extracted entity-linked opinion metadata before indexing and reduced Wasserstein distance to corpus sentiment distributions by 18-48% on two datasets, with human evaluators preferring its responses 79.2% of the time.

items.title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching
items.title_zh: 大工具空间中的长程计划执行：熵引导分支搜索
items.summary: The authors introduce SLATE, a large-scale context-aware e-commerce benchmark for tool-integrated agents, and find that current agents struggle with self-correction and search efficiency. They propose Entropy-Guided Branching, an uncertainty-aware search method that expands decision branches where predictive entropy is high, improving both task success and computational efficiency on SLATE.

items.title: Apr 13, 2026 Product Introducing ParseBench: The First Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents Read
items.title_zh: 推出 ParseBench：首个面向 AI 智能体阅读的文档解析基准
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced ParseBench, described as the first document parsing benchmark for how AI agents read documents; the captured excerpt contains no further detail on its tasks or results.

items.title: Enterprises power agentic workflows in Cloudflare Agent Cloud with OpenAI
items.title_zh: 企业在 Cloudflare Agent Cloud 上借助 OpenAI 驱动智能体工作流
items.summary: Cloudflare is bringing OpenAI's GPT-5.4 and Codex to Agent Cloud so enterprises can build, deploy and scale AI agents for real-world tasks with speed and security.
